title: The combined effect on survival of four main behavioural risk factors for non-communicable diseases
parameterType: mutually adjusted Cox hazard ratios, not Weibull absolute-risk coefficients
limitations: Historic Swiss cohorts; not a current Swiss calibration.
Study exposure categories are coarse and must not be relabelled as current guideline thresholds.
Do not append BMI, blood pressure or newer smoking coefficients from other studies.
Main-effect products and the separately reported all-four contrast are different estimates.
No coefficient covariance, current joint exposure distribution or absolute Weibull equation implemented.
The 0.99 female moderate-alcohol estimate is retained for faithful research comparison, not a health recommendation or calculator bonus.
